messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Error message in lavaan
parts: lavaan ERROR: sample covariance matrix is not positive-definite
because these is a negative value in varinace-covariance matrix?

No, you can have negative off-diagonal values (given certain constraints), but diagonal values should be positive.  You can look up what a non-positive definite matrix is on Wikipedia, or post general SEM questions on SEMNET:

www2.gsu.edu/~mkteer/semnet.html
